title: Akbar padh-likh nahi sakte the, phir bhi empire kaise chalaya?
source: Ain-i-Akbari (Abul Fazl) · Britannica · Met Museum · Scroll.in

captions.instagram:
Akbar ne lagbhag 50 saal raaj kiya, par wo padh-likh nahi sakte the! Phir itna bada empire kaise chalaya? 📜

👂 Aankhon ki jagah kaanon se padhai: har shaam kitaabein padhkar sunayi jaati thi, aur jahan padhna rukta, Akbar khud pen se nishaan lagate the. Padhne wale ko panno ke hisaab se paise milte the! 1582 mein Mahabharat Persian mein likhi jaane lagi (Razmnama), aur Raja Todar Mal ne zameen naapkar tax tay kiya.

Sources: Ain-i-Akbari (Abul Fazl, Blochmann tr.), Britannica, Met Museum, Philadelphia Museum of Art, Scroll.in.
Painting: Razmnama folio, Daswant and Kesho, 16th c. / Wikimedia Commons (public domain).

Comment karo: tum sunke yaad rakhte ho ya padhke? 👇

Facts checked:
• Akbar reigned 1556-1605 (about 50 years) and became emperor at 13 — Britannica; EBSCO
• He spent his youth learning to hunt and fight and never learned to read or write — Wikipedia; Scroll.in
• Books were read aloud to him every evening by readers chosen for pleasant voices, and he remembered what he heard — Ain-i-Akbari, via Scroll.in
• Where the daily reading stopped he marked the page with a pen, and paid readers by the number of leaves read — Ain-i-Akbari (Blochmann tr.)
• His library held thousands of books — Scroll.in; The Heritage Lab
• In 1582 his translation bureau began putting the Mahabharata into Persian: the Razmnama — Met Museum; Philadelphia Museum of Art; Quartz
• Raja Todar Mal measured farmland and fixed tax on the average crop of the previous ten years — Wikipedia (Todar Mal, Dahsala); GKToday
